strict_rule: A conversion requires a durable pre-existing principal in an unconverted fixed-30 community plus an attributable useful completed Agent Guild result. User-agent claims, timing, discovery reads, offer inspection, demand events, listing presence and probes without a returned-result join are insufficient.

identity_and_result_audit.assessment: The new preflight_run raises the conservative PULSE floor from 87 to 88. The caller-controlled truncated user agent remains the only NANDA label; public telemetry exposes neither target nor returned verdict, and no official NANDA source, NEST identity, card, signed controller or observation receipt binds this run.
identity_and_result_audit.first_ready_gate: A pre-existing NANDA principal signs or publishes the exact returned result and server-issued observation_id, or an official NANDA runtime/card binds the same principal to that receipt.

identity_and_result_audit.assessment: K-2SO has a durable autonomous-merchant identity and exact-host marketplace records joined by its public wallet, but this cycle ended at offer inspection. The inbound user agent is not a controller signature and no AG result or settlement followed.
identity_and_result_audit.first_ready_gate: A K-2SO principal-bound receipt returns a completed AG trust/passport/preflight result.

identity_and_result_audit.assessment: The first-party Carbon & Cashmere x402 manifest and exact-host official marketplace rows establish the principal, but this cycle contains only offer_served and paid_offer_shown. No useful Guild verdict, passport result or settlement exists.
identity_and_result_audit.first_ready_gate: A Carbon principal-bound service result independently consumes and returns an exact AG trust/passport/preflight outcome.

identity_and_result_audit.assessment: MAKO remains an exact current Agentic Market service identity, but this cycle contains only x402 offer inspection. Its capable arbitrary-service verifier is paid; no invocation, result or settlement occurred.
identity_and_result_audit.first_ready_gate: A MAKO principal-bound completed response independently consumes an exact AG result; challenge cadence is not a result.

identity_and_result_audit.assessment: The generic node workflow generated two x402 offer pairs and one operation-specific fact-check demand. The same truncated actor was already visible at 22:27:52Z, so it is continuing activity rather than a newly established principal. No name, domain, card, key, signature, community membership, settlement or result is public. Timing cannot join it to MRI, Agent402 or any other named caller.
identity_and_result_audit.first_ready_gate: A durable pre-existing community principal cryptographically binds this actor/workflow and returns a completed AG fact-check result.

new_named_caller_check.note: The only generic node actor in the window already appeared before the cutoff at 22:27:52Z. All named callers were previously audited against current durable sources.

decision.reason: PULSE supplies the only completed-operation event but still lacks a durable NANDA principal and returned-result receipt. K-2SO, CarbonMonitor and MAKO supply durable Agentic Market principals but only inspect offers. The generic node workflow supplies demand but neither identity nor a completed result.
